methods.what: Transforming a polynomial equation in x into one in z = x^2 by splitting into even and odd parts
Transformation to z = x^3 via splitting into three residue classes of exponents
Power sums of two quantities expressed in p = α+β and q = α²+β²
Fourth power sum in terms of p, q
Fifth power sum in terms of p, q
Sixth power sum in terms of p, q
Enumerating the six quadratic factors formed from pairs of the roots α,β,γ,δ of a quartic (resolvent of degree six)
Coefficient of a monomial term expressed via the number of permutations A
